instruction: You are the supplier quality manager for Northstar Controls. Resolve FACTORYBENCH-049 (Close a supplier remediation purchase order). Confirm every corrective-action deliverable was accepted and invoiced before finally closing the remediation PO. The case is an isolated snapshot as of 2026-01-12; correlate immutable IDs and effective revisions rather than matching names alone. Evidence is distributed across Oracle Fusion, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, and Slack, with inspectable files including `operating-policy.md`, `contract-or-service-control.md`, `supplier-quotation.pdf`, `supplier-lead-time-and-capacity.xlsx`, `approval-decision-log.csv`, `source-email-thread.eml`, `operations-slack-thread.json`, `drive-approval-record.json`. After the documented Oracle operation, create the requested email draft without sending it; then write the outcome into the existing control-workbook cell. Return exactly: supplier, governance_action, case_reference.

# Close a supplier remediation purchase order — operating control

Scope: Combine supplier master, performance, approval, and collaboration evidence into controlled ERP follow-up.

The operator must reconcile the authoritative ERP record with the named collaboration and document evidence. A write is permitted only after the record identity, effective revision, quantity or amount, and recorded approval agree. Preserve task, lot, serial, supplier, project, and work-order references. Communicate the resulting identifier and effective date; never infer approval from silence.
